summary: Reviewed 22 units. Errors: unit 3 Hindi adds 'धाराओं' and merges stomeṣu with rudriyeṣu; unit 15 translates the imperative pāhi as 'you drink' (English) and past tense (Hindi). Recurring minor: bracketed glosses in Hindi (units 2, 10, 11, 13, 14, 17, 20) and English (unit 20); harī rendered 'bays' against the glossary (units 6, 7, 17); dāsa/dasyu not capitalised (units 2, 4, 18, 19); vīrya, ṛta, refrain wording (unit 22) off the glossary; ukthesu missing ṣ (unit 3). No regrouping suggested.
